2.163.5
GaugePanel.CustomProperties
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The GaugePanel.CustomProperties element specifies custom information for a GaugePanel that will
be handed to a report rendering component. The GaugePanel.CustomProperties element is
optional. This element is of type CustomProperties.
The following is the parent element of the GaugePanel.CustomProperties element.
Parent elements
GaugePanel
The following is the XML Schema definition of the GaugePanel.CustomProperties element.
 <xsd:element name="CustomProperties" type="CustomPropertiesType" minOccurs="0" />
